title: Can’t stop sleeping 17 hours
content: For the past week I have been excessively sleeping. I sleep for about 9 hours, wake up for 5, then sleep another 9. So in a 24 hour day I’m spending like 5 hours awake. I’ve never had a problem like this. I have had mall world dream nightly for the past 3 years and sometimes when my dreams are more intense I sleep more. Anyone else have this going on right now ?
